South Korea's highest-paid math tutor makes $14 million a year, more than Son Heung-min, their most famous footballer. His name is Hyun Woo-jin. He graduated from Stanford's math department in three years and three months. His textbook series, Neuron, sells over a million copies a year. Every November, South Korea pauses for a single nine-hour exam called the Suneung. The Air Force halts training flights. For 35 minutes during the English listening section, no commercial flights can take off or land at Incheon, one of Asia's busiest airports. About 8,000 police officers escort late students on motorcycles with sirens running. Inside that exam, the most consequential questions are called killer questions. They're deliberately designed to fall outside the public school curriculum. They exist to separate the top one percent from everyone else, because that one percent gets into Seoul National, Korea, and Yonsei. The SKY universities that produce around 30% of Korea's top-1,000-company CEOs. Parents can't evaluate the curriculum themselves. They can't reverse-engineer the killer question. So they borrow Hyun Woo-jin's judgment. If your child went through Neuron and still failed, you did what every reasonable parent in the neighborhood does. The fault is your child's, or fate's. Not yours. That's what's actually being sold. Not math. Certainty. Korean households spent 29.2 trillion won on private tutoring in 2024, an all-time record, even as the school-age population dropped another 1.5%. A country is, in a measurable sense, choosing not to exist in order to keep paying for that certainty.

C'est quoi la vitamine C ? C'est un nutriment essentiel, également appelé acide ascorbique, que le corps humain ne peut ni fabriquer ni stocker, ce qui rend son apport quotidien par l'alimentation obligatoire. Elle joue un rôle d'antioxydant puissant en protégeant les cellules contre le vieillissement, tout en stimulant le système immunitaire pour aider le corps à se défendre contre les infections. Cette vitamine est aussi indispensable à la fabrication du collagène, une protéine qui structure la peau, les vaisseaux sanguins et les os, et elle double l'absorption du fer d'origine végétale dans l'intestin. On la trouve en abondance dans les fruits frais, particulièrement les agrumes, les kiwis et les baies, ainsi que dans les légumes crus comme les poivrons et le brocoli. il ya 1 miligramme de vitamine C dans une ejaculation #Asterion #jeudelabiscotte #vitaminec @Asterion

Ultra Creamy Buldak Ramen 🍝🥟 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 1–2 tbsp butter 2 cloves garlic (minced) 1 tbsp Kewpie mayo Buldak sauce packet Buldak powder packet 1 tbsp chili oil ¾–1 cup heavy cream Mozzarella cheese Dumplings Sausages Green onions Sesame seeds Extra chili oil (for topping) Instructions Cook noodles until al dente, then drain and set aside. In a pan, melt butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add Kewpie mayo, Buldak sauce, and powder packet. Mix well until it turns thick and glossy. Add chili oil and stir. Pour in heavy cream and mix until smooth, creamy, and slightly thickened (that rich orange color 🔥). Add noodles and toss until fully coated. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top and let it melt into the sauce. Add dumplings and sausages on top. Cover and let everything heat through. Finish with green onions, sesame seeds, and extra chili oil drizzle. . #buldak #buldakramen #eat #cook #Foodie

Key Health Benefits of Pilates: Deep Core Strength: Pilates targets the deep abdominal muscles and pelvic floor, creating a strong "powerhouse" that supports the spine and protects the back. Improved Posture and Alignment: By strengthening neglected postural muscles and promoting better body awareness, it helps correct slouching and alignment issues. Increased Flexibility and Mobility: The exercises focus on lengthening muscles while strengthening them, which improves joint mobility and overall flexibility. Reduced Back Pain and Injury Prevention: It strengthens muscles around the spine and hips, helping to alleviate pain and lower the risk of injuries. Toned Muscles Without Bulk: Using eccentric contraction, Pilates develops long, lean muscle tone rather than building mass. Mental Well-being and Stress Relief: The focus on precise movement and breathing promotes relaxation, reduces cortisol levels, and enhances mental concentration. Accessible Low-Impact Exercise: Because it is low-impact, it is accessible to various fitness levels and provides a safe way to exercise #fyp #targetaudience #pilates #motivation #pilatesbyizzy
